title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing, especially around cumulative angles.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The Session 2 app separates reachable and lost cells by blue and grey; some colour-blind users may find it hard to tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Reachable and lost cells distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: whole-arm collision checking
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: the Session 3 route checks only the gripper.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The mini-project says links are assumed to pass above the fixture; real arms cannot assume that.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: speed limits and timing
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses one fixed quintic timing; a real robot has speed and acceleration limits for each joint.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the move time is stretched until no joint exceeds its speed limit.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The 0.60 m move stays at or below 1.5 rad/s in every joint
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a 3D six-joint pick-and-place
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a planar pick-and-place with a swept workspace and a manipulability ellipse; there is no public implementation and no 3D version.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] End-effector error below 1e-6 m along the whole path
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
